overall_notes: This paper focuses on speech-to-text pre-training (SpeechUT) for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation (ST) tasks. The NLG evaluation is conducted using automatic metrics (WER for ASR, BLEU for ST) without any human or LLM-based evaluation. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed some cleanup of duplicates and clarification that baseline models mentioned should not be included in the primary models list.
